affected_run.reason: The run was launched from the merged v2.0 source-selection implementation before unresolved review findings were corrected. Any source-selection decision emitted by this run is invalid for freezing Study 3.

implementation_findings: The v2.0 selector incorrectly required complete observed action coverage, contradicting the frozen rule that permits a non-empty subset of the campaign catalog.
The v2.0 selector did not verify that each audit report campaign matched the candidate key supplied to the selector.
The v2.0 workflow downloaded the archive from a mutable URL without verifying it against the already frozen archive SHA256 before source selection.
The v2.0 selection record did not include the exact executing code SHA.
The lexical tie-break was frozen but not directly covered by a regression test.
corrective_rules: Accept logged actions only when they form a non-empty subset of the campaign catalog.
Require report.campaign to equal the candidate campaign name.
Require each audit report archive SHA256 to equal the frozen SHA256 in obd_source_lock.json.
Require overlapping BTS and Random timestamp ranges and positive row counts.
Record the exact executing code SHA in the source-selection result.
Keep the largest Random-policy row_count rule and lexical tie-break unchanged.
authorization: Exactly one corrected source-selection run is authorized after this erratum and its implementation fixes merge. No selected-campaign click outcome may be parsed before that corrected source is frozen and a separate Study 3 empirical design is prospectively locked.
